run_moolib_rpc_batch_server: run a moolib Rpc server that defines batched RPC methods and listens on a local address
test_moolib_define_batched_method: test the moolib Rpc define method to register a batched RPC handler with a batch size
test_moolib_define_deferred_method: test the moolib Rpc define_deferred method to register a deferred callback-based batched RPC handler
test_moolib_define_queue_method: test the moolib Rpc define_queue method to register an async queue-based batched RPC handler
test_moolib_async_client_call: test the moolib Rpc client async_ method to make asynchronous RPC calls to a server
